What I would value hearing about

I welcome relevant conversations about corporate law, legal education, commercial awareness, technology, and appropriate opportunities for a student at my stage.

I am currently studying International A Levels in Riyadh and working towards a future in corporate and commercial law. My interests include mergers and acquisitions, private equity, and the questions technology creates for businesses.

The connection

An introduction is most useful when it gives a little context.

Read the deeper context+

Tell me who you are, what prompted the message, and the specific subject you would like to discuss. If you are responding to a page or reflection in this portfolio, naming it will help me understand the connection.

02 / 04

For opportunities and learning experiences

For a school-supported activity, volunteering opportunity, event, or learning placement, useful details include the organisation, the expected activity, the time commitment, and any eligibility requirements.

This allows the conversation to begin with a realistic understanding of the opportunity and its suitability for a current school student.

The connection

I would especially value a chance to learn about professional work at a stage appropriate for a school student.

Read the deeper context+

Seeing how someone researches, communicates, and approaches a task would help me understand the profession more realistically. I am interested in learning opportunities and conversations about the path ahead.

03 / 04

For shared interests and feedback

I enjoy discussing the questions in my writing: AI governance, identity, cybersecurity, business, aviation, and how systems serve people.

If something makes you see the subject differently, I would like to hear why. A thoughtful question or another perspective can be the beginning of a useful conversation.

The connection

If something on the site needs correcting, tell me which page you noticed it on and what you think should change.

Read the deeper context+

I welcome clear, constructive feedback. It helps me improve the writing and make the website more useful for the next person who reads it.

How the message composer works

Choose a topic, enter your name and message, and select Prepare email.

The website will open your email application with an editable draft addressed to me. Review that draft and send it from your own account. Nothing is submitted by this website, and there is no confirmation of delivery here.

The connection

You can also email me directly or use the link to connect with me.

Read the deeper context+

The composer simply helps you prepare the wording; it does not save your message on a server. You review the draft and choose to send it from your own email account.
